metaTitle: Custom Arcane Portrait From Your Photo | Anime Cabinet
metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn custom Arcane portrait from your photo. Preview within 72 hours, unlimited free revisions, and a cinematic fan-art finish.
heroHeading: Your Story, Painted in Arcane Light
description: Bring your favorite Arcane-inspired mood to life with a custom Arcane portrait drawn by a human artist. Your photo becomes an original character portrait shaped by painterly brushwork, dramatic shadows, neon Undercity color, and warm Piltover-inspired gold. The result captures the cinematic texture and emotional intensity of the style while keeping your identity at the center. It is fan-art inspired, not a copied image of Vi, Jinx, Caitlyn, or any other copyrighted character.

Choose a clear photo, tell us the mood or color direction you want, and add details that make the artwork personal: a favorite jacket, hairstyle, piercings, expression, graffiti motif, or a split neon-and-gold background. Dramatic side lighting and serious expressions work especially well, but our artists can also turn a relaxed family photo, couple image, pet portrait, or cosplay reference into an original composition. Bone structure, eyes, hair color, and distinctive features remain recognizable beneath the painterly texture, so the finished arcane style portrait feels like you in a cinematic world rather than a generic character.

Anime Cabinet makes ordering simple. Select your portrait options, upload your reference photo, and describe the atmosphere you have in mind. You receive a preview within 72 hours, followed by unlimited free revisions so you can request adjustments to pose, color, expression, clothing, or background. Starting at $39.99, this custom cartoon portrait works as dramatic wall art, a gaming-room centerpiece, an anniversary keepsake, or a custom cartoon portrait gift for an Arcane fan. For more visual planning ideas, read our [Arcane-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/arcane-inspired-custom-poster), browse our [best gifts for Arcane fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-arcane-fans), or explore the full [Anime Cabinet portrait collection](/).

faqs.q: Where can I order a custom Arcane portrait based on my photo, and how much does it cost?
faqs.a: You can order a hand-drawn custom Arcane portrait directly from Anime Cabinet’s [Arcane portrait page](/portraits/arcane). Commissions start at $39.99, with the final price depending on factors such as the number of people, composition, and selected product format. An artist uses your photo as reference and creates an original Arcane-inspired character portrait rather than impersonating a copyrighted character or applying an AI filter.

faqs.q: How long does a custom Arcane portrait take, and can I request changes?
faqs.a: You receive a first preview within 72 hours under our standard service. Unlimited free revisions are included, allowing you to refine expressions, colours, backgrounds, or style details with the artist. You can request a digital file or a print-ready option, and the artwork can be commissioned as a custom cartoon portrait gift, couple portrait, or personal fan artwork. For the strongest result, send a well-lit photo and mention any preferred neon, gold, graffiti, or hextech-inspired details in your notes.
